note: Submodule of entity_hierarchy. Registers a breadcrumb_builder service entity_hierarchy.breadcrumb (class HierarchyBasedBreadcrumbBuilder) at priority 10 that builds breadcrumbs from an entity's entity_reference_hierarchy ancestor chain on canonical, non-admin entity routes. No config, no permissions, no Drush. Medium introspects the enabled service; hard toggles the module (uninstall -> agent enables -> verify installed + service present).

evals.prompt: I use Entity Hierarchy with a parent field on my pages. How do I make Drupal build each page's breadcrumb from that hierarchy field, and how much configuration does it need?
evals.expected_output: Enable the entity_hierarchy_breadcrumb submodule. There is no configuration: any entity type with an entity_reference_hierarchy field automatically gets breadcrumbs built from its ancestor chain.

evals.prompt: In entity_hierarchy_breadcrumb, what service provides the breadcrumbs and how is it registered (tag and priority)?
evals.expected_output: The service entity_hierarchy.breadcrumb (class HierarchyBasedBreadcrumbBuilder) is tagged breadcrumb_builder with priority 10.

evals.prompt: When does the entity_hierarchy_breadcrumb builder apply, and does it run on admin pages?
evals.expected_output: applies() is TRUE on a canonical entity route where the entity has an entity_reference_hierarchy field, and it does NOT apply on admin routes (it checks router.admin_context).

evals.prompt: On this site, is the entity_hierarchy_breadcrumb breadcrumb builder active, and what priority is its breadcrumb_builder service tagged with?
evals.expected_output: Yes; the entity_hierarchy.breadcrumb service is tagged breadcrumb_builder at priority 10 (inspect the service tag / container).

evals.prompt: This site uses Entity Hierarchy but breadcrumbs are not following the hierarchy. Turn on hierarchy-based breadcrumbs by installing the appropriate Entity Hierarchy submodule, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable entity_hierarchy_breadcrumb (drush en entity_hierarchy_breadcrumb -y). verify checks the module is installed and the entity_hierarchy.breadcrumb service exists.
